## File: facebookresearch_mhr/tools/mhr_create_segmentation/example.py

Prompts

```
['run the MHR segmentation script to export a color-coded segmented template mesh and part segments', 'build semantic joint groups from a list of joint names using the build_joint_groups function', 'compute per-vertex weights for each joint group from skin weights using compute_part_weights', 'map a joint name to its semantic group key using the joint_group_key function', 'review the MHR segmentation example that groups joints and computes vertex part weights']
```

Usage

```
{'run_mhr_segmentation': 'run the MHR segmentation script to export a color-coded segmented template mesh and part segments', 'build_joint_groups': 'build semantic joint groups from a list of joint names using the build_joint_groups function', 'compute_part_weights': 'compute per-vertex weights for each joint group from skin weights using compute_part_weights', 'map_joint_group_key': 'map a joint name to its semantic group key using the joint_group_key function', 'review_mhr_segmentation': 'review the MHR segmentation example that groups joints and computes vertex part weights'}
```
